semiconductor_relevance: High — ELES specializes in advanced test solutions for microelectronics, focusing on reliability and defect detection.
summary: ELES Semiconductor Equipment S.p.A. is an Italian SME that develops advanced test systems and applications for the semiconductor industry, emphasizing reliability and Zero Defects in critical applications. Their proprietary RETE methodology integrates functional testing with thermal and electrical stress to enhance product quality and reliability.
capabilities: Reliability Test Systems for High Power Density GPUs and AI Processors
Two-phase liquid cooling technology for high power density devices
In-situ testing capabilities with extensive data collection
Adaptive stress testing based on real-time calculations
